correctness.rationale: For n=2^r−1 (r≥2), the path adjacency has recurrence p_{m+1}=X p_m+p_{m−1} in characteristic 2, giving p_n=X^n and a cyclic J_n(0) via the endpoint Krylov basis. The rung adjacency is I_2+N_2 with N_2²=0, so ladder A=I+K where K is multiplication by x+y on F2[x,y]/(x^n,y²). Frobenius and a two-dimensional K-kernel yield precisely blocks J_{n+1}(0),J_{n−1}(0). For reversible second-order T=[[A,I],[I,0]], Φ(T)=T²+T+I=diag(K,K)T with T invertible, giving rank-nullity filtration 2min(j,n+1)+2min(j,n−1), hence two irreducible Φ-primary modules of powers n+1 and n−1. In characteristic 2, X^t−1 has Φ multiplicity 0 when 3∤t and 2^{ν₂(t)} otherwise, establishing fixed spaces, exact order 3·2^r, and all primitive orbits by differences of nested fixed sets. Direct explicit-neighbor XOR on all 4096 paired-row states of the n=3 ladder independently gave primitive state populations 1,15,240,3840 at periods 1,3,6,12.
